clusters.name: After the third child's birth, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around the birth of the third child in March 1995, you saw your mother described as worn out and on edge, then your father working late and rarely home, then your own stomach aches and missed school, then shouting matches between your father and brother, and by September 1996 your mother not going back to her job; these fall within about a year and a half of the birth and suggest a broader process moving through the family around that change.
